note: Synthetic entries written for testing the reader prompt. They are not anyone's real journal. person_labels is empty on purpose: only a person can label an entry.

entries.text: Woke up at five again with my chest tight. I kept going over the conversation with my brother and what I should have said. I didn't choose to think about it, it just kept coming back.
I really wanted the second glass of wine tonight, but I told myself no and went for a walk instead. Proud of that, honestly.
Spent the whole afternoon on the design and lost track of time. Every piece clicked. I could see the finished thing in my head before I drew it.
It's been a year since Grandma died. I made her soup recipe tonight and cried while it simmered. I miss her calling on Sundays.
Stood on the ridge as the sun came up over the valley. It was so beautiful it felt holy, like I was being shown something I didn't earn.
My manager asked me to sign off on numbers I know are padded. I laid out the logic three times and it doesn't add up, and it isn't right either. I'm not signing.
Noticed I was scrolling for an hour without really being there. Put the phone down and just sat and watched my own thoughts for a while.
Everyone at the party seemed to want me to be the funny one again. I'm not that person anymore and I said so, which felt strange but true.
